newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FAKTO LAUNCHES 4.4 MILLION KROON SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: FAKTO LAUNCHES 4.4 MILLION KROON SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto on Monday launched a 4.4 million kroons share issue, which investment house Baltic Cresco said should be well received.
"We expect the share issue to be well subscribed as the market is expanding in the Baltic countries," Indrek Rahumaa, Baltic Cresco's head of corporate finance, told Reuters.
"As better economic growth continues and leasing services improve, the market will improve as well," he added.
The company will issue 444,588 10 kroons shares for a sale price of 28 kroons.
Fakto is not just a retail company as it also holds 65 percent of the distributor for Nissan in the Baltics.
"Fakto also owns 65 percent of wholesaler Nissan Baltic, the distributor for Nissan in the three Baltic countries," he added.
Rahumaa said the remaining 35 percent of Nissan Baltic was held by the Japanese global distributor for Nissan, Marubeni Corp .
The issue will be arranged by Cresco and after the issue Fakto will seek listing on the Tallinn stock exchange.
After the share issue, the company's equity capital will be 14.7 million kroons.
The company's profit for 1996 was 1.56 million kroons and it had a turnover of 146 million kroons.
